text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —...A cursed videotape of...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It was just sitting in the middle of the common room.
I asked everyone, but no one seemed to recognize it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's a little scary, but I'm super curious!
So, Kura-chan, wanna come with me?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, fair enough.
Let's see what you've got...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Well then... I'm going to start playing the track.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah! Look, there's text on the screen...!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "This is a cursed video. A curse shall befall all who watch it"... you say?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wah!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Eh!? A blackout!?

text_block_list.name: Cursed Footsteps
text_block_list.text: (Clatter-thud!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Eek!?

text_block_list.name: Cursed Videotape
text_block_list.text:
"Wahahaha! Fear me, fear me!
For I am a curse, I say~!!"

text_block_list.name: Cursed Videotape
text_block_list.text:
"You won't escape from us ever again!
Because my legs are the fastest in the world~!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Is this a real curse?!
W-What should I do? A lifetime is...--

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, Kita-chan!
I'll take full responsibility and—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Wait! Leave this to me!
It's frustrating to just take it lying down!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hey, you! Where are you from?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Even with curses, there must be all sorts, right?!
Like different rules depending on the country or region!

text_block_list.name: Cursed Videotape
text_block_list.text:
"...L-Like I'd tell you~!
It's useless trying to pry information out of me~!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... You've got sharp instincts—
In that case, at the very least...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Run with me!
You're an Umamusume, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"My legs are the fastest in the world"...
I could feel her sheer confidence that she wouldn't lose with her legs!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Race against me!!
I'll defeat you and break this curse!

text_block_list.name: Cursed Videotape
text_block_list.text:
"...Wh-What?! You wanna race?!
B-But... this one is number one, you know!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
! Wait, are you getting flustered?
...Amazing! That's incredible, Kura-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
M-My, it seems rather noisy over there, isn't it?
Wait...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san,
what are you doing behind the sliding door?

The large room seems awfully noisy.
Curious, I decide to take a peek inside...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Because~ summer is all about horror, right?
I was just trying to entertain everyone~!"
choice_data_list: Were you doing a test of courage or something?
Were you doing a test of courage or something?
Looks like everyone was having fun playing together.
Looks like everyone was having fun playing together, huh.
True, it might feel a bit like summer...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Because~ summer is all about horror, right?
I was just trying to entertain everyone~!"
choice_data_list: Were you doing a test of courage or something?
Were you doing a test of courage or something?
Looks like everyone was having fun playing together.
Looks like everyone was having fun playing together, huh.
True, it might feel a bit like summer...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I know, but... I'm just not satisfied!
I wanted them to be way more scared, and besides—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Race against me!!
I'll defeat you and break this curse!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Crown might've said that just now, but...
I'm going to be number one in the race too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's you, Teio-san,
I have no intention of handing over the crown, you know?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I believe I'm putting in enough effort to be able to say that with pride. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Let's run together next time!
Whether my words are true or not... we'll see then!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah, it was actually pretty fun!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Kura-chan was amazing just now!
She was so dependable!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Yeah!! That was super duper cool!
Man, you're truly amazing, Kura-chan~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
When it comes to negotiations, I'd like to think I have plenty of experience♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's right! It's summer, after all!
It'd be a total waste if we didn't enjoy it~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, what a wonderful summer memory!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Speaking of summer memories,
I really wanna go to the beach with everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The beach sounds lovely.
Having lunch at a beach hut sounds delightful as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll take charge!
Leave schedule management to me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I will make sure to help you make
the best summer memories♪
